sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Ivan Yegorovich Kharitonov, known by his alias "Jaeger", is a trader in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Biography
sections.text: Before the conflict, he worked as a hunter in the Priozersk Natural Reserve under the State Hunting Service. A professional hunter and survival specialist. Even now, he still guards the reserve's hunting grounds from various aggressive individuals.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: Jaeger is initially locked, and can be unlocked through Mechanic's quest Introduction.
